items.title: Tier B · Emerging / specialized
Skills

items.description:
HTML is the better authoring format, but many decks end up with someone who only works in PowerPoint — a client who wants to change the numbers, an event that only accepts uploads, a team whose templates live in Office. "Export to PPTX" can mean two quite different files, so check which one a tool produces:
Built into skills on this list
Converting an existing HTML deck
Anthropic's skill (in ) used to ship an workflow — author slides as HTML, convert them with a bundled script. That workflow was removed in February 2026; the current skill has the agent write PptxGenJS scripts directly, plus validation and thumbnail tools. It fits when you are happy for the agent to rebuild the deck natively rather than convert your HTML. The skill is source-available under a proprietary license.
Rasterize, then rebuild
When a deck relies on things a DOM-to-shape converter can't follow (WebGL backgrounds, canvas, 3D), export it to PDF or slide screenshots first — most skills above can export PDF, or print from Chrome — then use a tool that reconstructs editable text boxes and shapes from the images:
